direct_evidence.body:
Correccion a la ruta de escalacion de RCS-28881, tipo APIS on-prem.

La referencia de escalacion L3 que tenia anotada apuntaba a una transicion manual a AALPS con
Matt Kamminga como owner de APIS. Shandana Khan corrigio esto en Teams el viernes 2:21 a.m., en
respuesta directa a Juan sobre este mismo ticket.

Texto literal de Shandana: "it looks like you're still going back and forth with the customer
gathering more details on it. when you need to escalate to Engineering, just set it to Under
Engineering review and we'll get to it in priority order".

Verificado por Juan, mensaje directo de Shandana en el hilo del ticket.

Ruta correcta para escalar RCS-28881 a ingenieria: cambiar el estado del ticket a Under Engineering
review. No requiere transicion a AALPS ni asignacion manual a un ingeniero. El ENG se autocrea con
la transicion y entra a la cola de Shandana en orden de prioridad.

Esto puede ser especifico de como Shandana maneja su cola, no necesariamente reemplaza la tabla

direct_evidence.title: 2026-10-01-rcs-28881-comentario-interno-har | Still open
direct_evidence.body:
## Still open

1. Does admin_config_form.asp hold a session lock while streaming, explaining why unrelated requests from the same session stall together.
2. Why does generating this template take over 21 minutes server side when the first byte arrives in 3.6s.
3. Does the missing AUDIT.STATUS label pair add per field delay here.

Customer asked for an ETA today, over two weeks since opened, flags a bigger audit that may hit the same wall. **Priority review requested.**

direct_evidence.title: 2026-10-01-rcs-28881-comentario-interno-har | Ruled out
direct_evidence.body:
## Ruled out

| Hypothesis | Refutation |
|---|---|
| Browser render thread blocking | TTFB was 3.6s, the delay is server side receive, DevTools stayed responsive |
| Session cookie lost | Fresh incognito login straight to 576 still hung the same way, 23 Sep |
| Edge timeout at 100s | Holds over 21 minutes, ends in 200, no 504 or 524 |
